findings.findingDetails: Using wildcards (*) in the action and the resource can allow creation of unintended service-linked roles because it allows iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole permissions on all resources. We recommend that you specify resource ARNs instead.

Using wildcards (*) in the action and the resource can be overly permissive because it allows iam:PassRole permissions on all resources. We recommend that you specify resource ARNs or add the iam:PassedToService condition key to your statement.
